title: GuestEventStatusDocument
description: What one guest's own records say about one event, at guestEventStatuses/{eventId}_{uid}: their Catch booking, roster place, website or offer payment, application and offer invitation. Triggers rebuild it from those records whenever one of them changes; a guest with no such record has no row. Only the guest reads it, and it never holds CRM notes, answers, phone numbers or invitation tokens. The website's event page reads it with the event's eventGuestEntries document and decides the guest's next step in the browser. It grants nothing: booking, checkout, application and offer commands keep reading the authoritative documents.

booking.description: registered: a Catch booking, a registered or checked-in roster row, or an admitted website payment. waitlisted: a waitlisted roster row.

ambiguous.description: More than one roster row, an inconsistent roster row or more than twenty offer invitations: only the booking and an offer payment are certain.

runtimeId.description: The event's public runtime, for a registered guest when runtime access is on.

publicPaymentId.description: The guest's latest website payment for the event.

paymentRecoverable.description: That payment is neither admitted nor expired, failed, cancelled or refunded, and the guest has no place.

offerPaymentId.description: The guest's latest offer payment for the event.

offerGrantId.description: The latest claimed offer invitation the guest can still use, identified by its stored hash, never its token.

offerAdmissible.description: The event admits offers without cohort, membership or Cross Paths admission.

offerAmbiguous.description: Usable invitations point at different offers.

applicationStatus.description: The guest's latest application to the event; withdrawn when its participant grant was revoked.
